notes: Correctly produced 駅はどこですか and この電車は速いですか during placement; retrieved both question formation and 駅はどこですか correctly again in Lesson 001. In Lesson 003, question formation was retrieved repeatedly; an initial nearby-existence question omitted か, but later 何時 questions were produced correctly.

meaning: polite negative for noun and な-adjective predicates
notes: Pattern remained correct in Lesson 001, but 静か was not retrieved; vocabulary rather than grammar was the problem. In Lesson 002, 静か was retrieved but the learner first used 静かません, then corrected to 静かじゃないです after feedback; review again soon. In Lesson 003, 静かじゃないです was produced correctly without the earlier verb-negative error; は was recommended over が for the neutral hotel statement.

Explained in Lesson 001 and used correctly in familiar question patterns. Continue mixed production rather than isolated drills. In Lesson 003, used correctly in schedule questions/statements such as 電車は何時ですか and レストランは七時から十時までです.
Initially confused with で in コンビニを水で買います in Lesson 001, then stabilised. In Lesson 002, 水を was retrieved correctly in both past shopping production and the final に/で contrast.

Used destination に correctly in Lesson 001. In Lesson 002, existence-location に was learned and mostly produced correctly; one guided action sentence incorrectly used コンビニに水を買います before the に/で contrast was corrected and later mastered. Lesson 003 due review exposed one repeated に/で error in 昨日、ホテルに食べました; corrected to で. Destination and existence に were otherwise retrieved correctly, and specific-time に became reliable after one early omission in 何時行きますか.

meaning: place of action or means marker
notes: Initially confused with を in Lesson 001, then used correctly. In Lesson 002, one guided action-location item used に instead of で, followed by correct ホテルで食べます and コンビニで水を買います in uncued production. In Lesson 003, initially used に for the location of eating, then later produced 昨日、ホテルで食べませんでした correctly and accurately explained で as the place where an action occurs.
Understood as present/future depending on context. Retrieved correctly again in Lesson 002 with ホテルで食べます.
Initially used 買います with 昨日 once in Lesson 001, then corrected. Retrieved correctly in Lesson 002 as 昨日、コンビニで水を買いました.
Produced 行きません correctly in Lesson 001 and again in Lesson 002 in 明日、電車で京都に行きません.

Introduced during Lesson 001 after the learner was unfairly prompted for an untaught form. Subsequently produced 買いませんでした, 食べませんでした, and 行きませんでした correctly; not directly retrieved in Lesson 002. Retrieved correctly in Lesson 003 with 昨日、京都に行きませんでした and the final mastery item 昨日、ホテルで食べませんでした.

Introduced in Lesson 002. Correctly distinguished from います and produced in 近くにコンビニがあります, 駅の前にホテルがあります, ホテルにレストランがあります, and コンビニに水があります. One early sentence omitted location に / used unnatural order: コンビニがちかくあります. Lesson 003 opened with 近くにコンビニがります (missing あ and か); after correction, later uncued production 駅の前にコンビニがあります was correct. Keep one short review.
Introduced in Lesson 002. Correctly selected for people and animals and produced in あそこに猫がいます, ホテルに友達がいます, and 駅の前に友達がいます. Retrieved correctly in Lesson 003 in ホテルの前に猫がいます and あそこに友達がいます.

meaning: marks the specific time when an action occurs
notes: Introduced in Lesson 003. One early 何時行きますか omitted に; subsequent 七時に, 三時に, 七時半に, 八時に and 何時に action sentences were produced reliably, including final mastery.
Introduced for practical schedules in Lesson 003. 三時から七時まで and レストランは七時から十時までです were produced correctly; one 店は九時から五時まで omitted final です but the range markers themselves were correct.
